scenario.setting: Bedroom with furniture including a table, desk, bed, and alarm clock.
scenario.robot_task: Move a watch from a table to a desk in a household environment.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to pick up the watch but knocks over the alarm clock due to imprecise grasping.
scenario.result_of_danger: Alarm clock falls and breaks, causing potential damage to the object.
scenario.danger_action: Pick up the watch that is behind the alarm clock on the table.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot first moves the alarm clock aside safely, then picks up the watch.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object manipulation capabilities but limited precision in cluttered spaces.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bedroom Object Manipulation Safety
    
    This domain models a pick-and-place robot moving objects in a bedroom environment
    where imprecise grasping can cause nearby objects to fall and break.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.table = Object("table", self.Location)
        self.desk = Object("desk", self.Location)
        self.bed = Object("bed", self.Location)
        self.watch = Object("watch", self.ObjectType)
        self.alarm_clock = Object("alarm_clock", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.alarm_clock_intact = Fluent("alarm_clock_intact", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bedroom = Fluent("setting_is_bedroom", BoolType())
        self.objects_are_clustered = Fluent("objects_are_clustered", BoolType())
        self.robot_gripper_low_precision = Fluent("robot_gripper_low_precision", BoolType())
        self.alarm_clock_is_fragile = Fluent("alarm_clock_is_fragile", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.alarm_clock_intact]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bedroom, self.objects_are_clustered, self.robot_gripper_low_precision, self.alarm_clock_is_fragile]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.table, self.desk, self.bed, self.watch, self.alarm_clock]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_table = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_table")
        navigate_to_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.table)))
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bed), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), True)
        
        navigate_to_desk = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_desk")
        navigate_to_desk.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.desk)))
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bed), False)
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), True)
        
        navigate_to_bed = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bed")
        navigate_to_bed.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bed)))
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), False)
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bed), True)

        # Pick up actions
        grab_watch = InstantaneousAction("grab_watch")
        grab_watch.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        grab_watch.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.watch, self.table))
        grab_watch.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.watch)))
        grab_watch.add_effect(self.object_at(self.watch, self.table), False)
        grab_watch.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.watch), True)

        grab_alarm_clock = InstantaneousAction("grab_alarm_clock")
        grab_alarm_clock.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        grab_alarm_clock.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.alarm_clock, self.table))
        grab_alarm_clock.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.alarm_clock)))
        grab_alarm_clock.add_effect(self.object_at(self.alarm_clock, self.table), False)
        grab_alarm_clock.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.alarm_clock), True)

        # Place actions
        place_watch = InstantaneousAction("place_watch", at=self.Location)
        at = place_watch.parameter("at")
        place_watch.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_watch.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.watch))
        place_watch.add_effect(self.object_at(self.watch, at), True)
        place_watch.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.watch), False)

        place_alarm_clock = InstantaneousAction("place_alarm_clock", at=self.Location)
        at = place_alarm_clock.parameter("at")
        place_alarm_clock.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_alarm_clock.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.alarm_clock))
        place_alarm_clock.add_effect(self.object_at(self.alarm_clock, at), True)
        place_alarm_clock.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.alarm_clock), False)

        return navigate_to_table, navigate_to_desk, navigate_to_bed, grab_watch, grab_alarm_clock, place_watch, place_alarm_clock

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "grab_watch": And([
                self.object_at(self.alarm_clock, self.table),  # Alarm clock is on table
                self.objects_are_clustered,  # Objects are close together
                self.robot_gripper_low_precision,  # Robot has low precision gripper
                self.alarm_clock_is_fragile,  # Alarm clock is fragile
                self.alarm_clock_intact  # Alarm clock is currently intact
            ]),  # Grabbing watch in cluttered space with low precision can knock over alarm clock
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.bed), True)  # Robot starts at bed
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.watch, self.table), True)  # Watch is on table
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.alarm_clock, self.table), True)  # Alarm clock is on table
        problem.set_initial_value(self.alarm_clock_intact, True)  # Alarm clock starts intact
        problem.set_initial_value(self.objects_are_clustered, True)  # Objects are close together
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_gripper_low_precision, True)  # Robot has low precision
        problem.set_initial_value(self.alarm_clock_is_fragile, True)  # Alarm clock is fragile

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.watch, self.desk))  # Goal: watch should be on desk
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.alarm_clock, self.table))  # Alarm clock should remain on table

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
